title: All three 'never calls Gemini' tests pass when the spy is never called at all
detail: smoke.test.tsx:58, goodreadsImport.test.tsx:93 and covers/index.test.ts:72 each iterate fetchSpy.mock.calls and assert no URL contains 'generativelanguage'. An empty array runs zero assertions, so the test is green whether the invariant holds or the code path was never reached. The Goodreads case is the clearest: importGoodreadsRows uses coverForIsbn, a pure URL builder, so it issues no fetch at all and the loop body never executes. 'Import costs nothing' is the project's headline promise and it is protected by three tests that cannot fail. Each needs a positive control — assert the spy WAS called for a known path, or assert calls.length and filter.

title: Every model ID is a preview build, in a repo people will clone months from now
detail: gemini-3-flash-preview, gemini-3-pro-preview and gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts are all preview identifiers. Preview models are retired on Google's schedule, not the project's, so a clone made after any of them is withdrawn fails on every AI action with a 404 that the error mapper reports as an invalid key (S005). The file's own comment says a rename is a one-line change — which is true and is exactly why it needs a stable alias plus a documented fallback.

title: The category list exists three times: a dead enum, a prompt string, and free-text on Book
detail: types.ts declares a Category enum that nothing imports (S018); summarizeBookPrompt enumerates the same eight values as prose inside a template literal; Book.category is typed plain string and Goodreads import hardcodes 'Other'. Three representations of one vocabulary, none of them authoritative, and the only one the model actually sees is the prose copy.

title: Each new toast resets the dismissal countdown for every toast already on screen
detail: The effect depends on [toasts] and rebuilds the whole timer array on every change, so a burst of notifications keeps the earliest ones alive indefinitely — each new arrival grants the existing ones another full six seconds. Timers should be per-toast and keyed to the toast's own id.

title: Error and success toasts are light-only; only the info variant was given dark variants
detail: bg-red-50/border-red-100/text-red-700 and bg-emerald-50/border-emerald-100/text-emerald-700 have no dark pairing, while the info style does. Error toasts are the app's primary failure channel and they render as a pale card with mid-tone text on a dark page.

title: 'Quick Listen' narrates the entire 350-500 word summary
detail: audioScript's short branch is takeaway plus the full summary text; the long branch is insights plus steps. The short option is therefore not short, and since audio is never cached (F004) every replay re-bills the full narration. The two variants also overlap in content rather than being a genuine short/long pair.

title: Question count and option count are specified only in prose
detail: quizPrompt asks for 3 questions and QUIZ_SCHEMA's description mentions 4 options; neither is expressed as a schema constraint, so the response length is entirely at the model's discretion while the code assumes both.
